subject: gk
question: Which of the following institutions conducts the survey on employment and unemployment?

options.text: National Institution of Economic and Social Research
National Council of Applied Economic Research

solution:
The correct answer is __**National Sample Survey Organisation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• **National Sample Survey Organisation was the largest organization in India conducting periodic socio-economic surveys**__.

 __
 
• It was established in the year 1950.
 
• It comes under the Ministry of Statistics of the Government of India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Name**
 **Details**
 
 

 National Council of Applied Economic Research
 
 
 
• It is a New Delhi-based non-profit think tank of economics.
 
• Nandan Nilekani is the president of the governing body and Poonam Gupta is the current director-general of NCAER
 
 
 
 

 Niti Aayog
 
 
 
• It is the apex Public Policy think tank of the Government of India.
 
• Formed on 1 January 2015.
 
• Its headquarters is in New Delhi.
 
 
 
 

 National Institution of Economic and Social Research
 
 
 
• It is the British oldest independent economic research institute established in 1938
 
• Its headquarters is located in London, United Kingdom
